type.description: Classify the complete standalone workout, not an interval or pace segment embedded inside another workout.

distance_km.description: Total distance of this complete workout. Do not put only the distance of its work intervals here.

duration_min.description: Total elapsed duration of this complete workout, including warm-up, recoveries, and cool-down; not only work-interval time.

intensity.description: Describe every component of this one workout here, including any race-pace blocks embedded in a long run.

workout_structure.description: Canonical running-workout blocks. Repeated interval work and recovery belong in the same block.

items.description: Exactly one independently performed workout. Embedded blocks are components of this object and must not be repeated as sibling key_sessions.
